in_marathi.name: Padmavati
in_marathi.long_meaning: Padmavati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Padmavati is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Padma', which means lotus. The suffix 'Vati' denotes 'seat' or 'place'. This name is believed to symbolize the seat or abode of the Goddess Padma or Saraswati. Padmavati is often revered as an embodiment of grace, beauty, and knowledge.
